hooks.text: 自由穿梭修仙、历史、武侠、魔法和未来位面
hooks.excerpt: The protagonist awakens the power and can freely travel through different planes such as Xiuxian, history, martial arts, Qi, magic, and future.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 招募时只是普通武者的人也能一路培养成神
hooks.excerpt: These characters have different talents and qualifications, when recruiting, he may be just a warrior or a warrior, but as long as the training, any character can be broken into a god!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 异界宝物能变现，灵兽还能进公司打工或进动物园卖票
hooks.excerpt: You can sell the treasures in the real world for money, you can arrange the spirits of the sky to work for you in your company, and you can even put the captured spirits in the zoo for admission. These revenues will fund your exploration of even more powerful dimensions!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
